lines.speaker: survivor_ives
lines.text: Mind the third bridge, it's rope over rope now. We lost a man to it in spring and we still call it the good one.

lines.speaker: survivor_ives
lines.text: Forty-one of us on these roofs. My grandmother said nine million once and I told her to stop lying to children.

lines.speaker: survivor_ives
lines.text: There's a thing in the stairwells. Comes up with the tide, looks like someone you knew, and it isn't. Don't answer it.

lines.speaker: survivor_ives
lines.text: You went down there, then. Nobody's done that in my lifetime and come back up talking.

lines.speaker: survivor_ives
lines.text: Water's lower this year. Two steps lower. Nobody can tell me why and I've stopped asking the kind of question that has no answer.

lines.speaker: survivor_ives
lines.text: Heard your century's got walls and rations and a machine doing the counting. Ours has got weather. I'll keep the weather.
